== Lead photograph (30 Oct 2026) ==
The lead is a crop of a Facebook photograph posted 12 August 2024. The Facebook photo viewer names Michael Lierheimer. Identification: distinctive name plus Red 102 on the Decipher Squadron roster (Langenbach, Ger). The Facebook profile is facebook.com/michael.lierheimer and lists Augsburg, Germany (same region of Bavaria as Langenbach). Decipher published a Red 102 profile for Michael Lierheimer of Langenbach.
Wiki File is the dest JPEG of the photograph. The File page Preserved copy is the Facebook photo-viewer screenshot. Identification stays on Talk. See [[:File:Michael Lierheimer portrait.jpg]] and [[:File:Michael Lierheimer Facebook portrait.jpg]].
